# interval during

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalDuring`](gmeow-intervalDuring.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalDuring>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen DURING: this interval's extent falls strictly within the related interval's extent. Transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:intervalContains`](gmeow-intervalContains.md). (= [time:intervalDuring](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalDuring))

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when one interval falls strictly inside another with both endpoints interior — a break within a workday, an episode within an era, with no shared boundary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the intervals share a start (use [`gmeow:intervalStarts`](gmeow-intervalStarts.md)) or end (use [`gmeow:intervalFinishes`](gmeow-intervalFinishes.md)); DURING requires both endpoints strictly inside. Distinct from [`gmeow:periodPartOf`](gmeow-periodPartOf.md), which nests NamedPeriods, not intervals.

### How to use

- Assert from the inner interval to the enclosing one; transitive, so it chains through nested intervals, and the inverse [`gmeow:intervalContains`](gmeow-intervalContains.md) follows (= [time:intervalDuring](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalDuring)).

### Examples

- ex:lunchBreak [`gmeow:intervalDuring`](gmeow-intervalDuring.md) ex:workday.
